summary: Practise incident classification, escalation and breach records with practical exercises. Explore the five-day incident response training course.
lede: Incident response training helps IT, security and service-continuity professionals classify incidents, assess impact and coordinate response decisions. It is for people who assess, document, coordinate or support recovery from IT security incidents and potential data breaches. Practical exercises cover incident timelines and action logs, escalation routes, evidence handoffs, breach-status updates and recovery checks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who help assess, coordinate, document or recover from IT security incidents and potential data breaches.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace IT systems and security incident terminology is expected. No previous incident-response role or coding experience is required.
